name: Clonoxels
definition: A voxel-based framework that automatically detects repeated objects within a scene using instance and semantic segmentation, aligns them via rigid registration, and shares voxel features between instances to improve reconstruction quality and reduce storage requirements.
summary: Clonoxels is a voxel-based radiance field framework that improves reconstruction quality and reduces storage by sharing features between repeated objects via instance segmentation and rigid registration.
